eps.ov: 20 years after it's win over the Aposdoll invaders, the giant robot, Dandivine, seems like a fading memory...

eps.t: An Ace, but Only Because of His Face
eps.ov: As he worries about his relationship, Gekiha finds himself in Dandivine's cockpit with the Aposdolls' return.
Gekiha is officially Dandivine's new pilot, but will his new duties allow him to attend to his love life?
A new transfer student named Suruga arrives at Gekiha's school and makes a huge impact.
Gekiha and Suruga each ponder the identity of their rival robot's pilot, blind to the truth.
Gekiha is injured and bedridden, leaving Dandivine without a pilot.
Gekiha has lost both Akane and Dandivine to Suruga. But will he give them up without a fight?
The three evil sisters, Aki, Natsu, and Haru, show up at Gekiha's school and try to seduce him.
